tools.name: search
tools.description: Search PickZeal tools and articles by keyword, for example "merge pdf", "word count" or "llm 8gb ram". Returns titles, URLs and short descriptions, best match first.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List every free in-browser tool on PickZeal with its URL, category and description.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List every article on the PickZeal blog with its URL, tags and description, newest first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
